mapper.sql: id, division_id, season_id, team_id, player_id, member_id, grant_status, active_unique_key, valid_from, valid_to, granted_by, remark, grant_source, source_draw_team_id, create_time, update_time, is_delete
mapper.select: select from basket_captain_grant where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
select from basket_captain_grant where is_delete = 0 order by id desc

select g.id, g.season_id, se.display_title as season_title, g.division_id, d.division_name, d.platform_code, g.team_id, t.team_name, g.player_id, coalesce(p.game_nickname, mp.nickname) as player_name, g.member_id, mp.nickname as member_nickname, g.grant_status, g.valid_from, g.valid_to, g.remark, g.grant_source, case when g.team_id is null then '尚未绑定球队' else t.team_name end as team_bound_label, g.create_time from basket_captain_grant g left join basket_season se on se.id = g.season_id and se.is_delete = 0 left join basket_division d on d.id = g.division_id and d.is_delete = 0 left join basket_team t on t.id = g.team_id and t.is_delete = 0 left join basket_player_profile p on p.id = g.player_id and p.is_delete = 0 left join basket_member_profile mp on mp.member_id = g.member_id and mp.is_delete = 0 where g.is_delete = 0 and g.season_id = #{seasonId} and g.division_id = #{divisionId} and g.team_id = #{teamId} and g.player_id = #{playerId} and g.grant_status = #{grantStatus} and t.team_name like concat('%', #{teamName}, '%') and coalesce(p.game_nickname, mp.nickname) like concat('%', #{playerName}, '%') order by g.id desc
select from basket_captain_grant where and division_id = #{divisionId} and team_id = #{teamId} and grant_status = 'ACTIVE' and active_unique_key is not null limit 1
select from basket_captain_grant where and division_id = #{divisionId} and player_id = #{playerId} and grant_status = 'ACTIVE' and active_unique_key is not null limit 1
select from basket_captain_grant where member_id = #{memberId} and grant_status = 'ACTIVE' and order by create_time desc, id desc limit 1
select from basket_captain_grant where player_id = #{playerId} and grant_status = 'ACTIVE' and order by create_time desc, id desc limit 1

select count(1) from basket_captain_grant g inner join basket_player_profile pp on pp.id = g.player_id and pp.is_delete = 0 where g.player_id = #{playerId} and g.grant_status = 'ACTIVE' and g.is_delete = 0 and pp.certification_status = 3 and (g.valid_from is null or g.valid_from <= now()) and (g.valid_to is null or g.valid_to >= now())

select g.id as qualificationId, cast(g.id as char) as qualificationNo, case g.grant_status when 'ACTIVE' then 1 when 'REVOKED' then 2 when 'EXPIRED' then 3 else null end as qualificationStatus, se.display_title as seasonName, s.series_name as tournamentName, coalesce(nullif(trim(se.display_title), ''), s.series_name, d.division_name) as eventName, g.team_id as teamId, t.team_name as teamName, 1 as paymentConfirmed, g.create_time as grantedTime, g.valid_to as validTo, g.granted_by as grantedBy, su.nick_name as grantedByName, case when g.grant_status = 'REVOKED' then g.update_time else null end as revokedTime, g.remark as revokeReason from basket_captain_grant g left join basket_season se on se.id = g.season_id and se.is_delete = 0 left join basket_series s on s.id = se.series_id and s.is_delete = 0 left join basket_division d on d.id = g.division_id and d.is_delete = 0 left join basket_team t on t.id = g.team_id and t.is_delete = 0 left join sys_user su on su.user_id = g.granted_by where g.member_id = #{memberId} and g.is_delete = 0 order by g.create_time desc, g.id desc
select from basket_captain_grant where source_draw_team_id = #{sourceDrawTeamId} and order by id desc

update basket_captain_grant
division_id = #{divisionId}, season_id = #{seasonId}, team_id = #{teamId}, player_id = #{playerId}, member_id = #{memberId}, grant_status = #{grantStatus}, active_unique_key = #{activeUniqueKey}, valid_from = #{validFrom}, valid_to = #{validTo}, granted_by = #{grantedBy}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = now()
where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
update basket_captain_grant set grant_status = 'REVOKED', active_unique_key = null, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and and grant_status = 'ACTIVE'
update basket_captain_grant set grant_status = 'EXPIRED', active_unique_key = null, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and and grant_status = 'ACTIVE'
update basket_captain_grant set team_id = #{teamId}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and and grant_status = 'ACTIVE' and team_id is null
update basket_captain_grant set grant_status = 'REVOKED', active_unique_key = null, update_time = now() where source_draw_team_id = #{sourceDrawTeamId} and grant_status = 'ACTIVE' and
update basket_captain_grant set is_delete = 1, active_unique_key = null, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and
